nodes.knowledge_target: enter city → water-carrier → follow → householder → upper room → prepare
nodes.why_this_node_exists: Uses only explicit Mark/Luke local order and provides a nonvisual ordering mechanic.
nodes.player_prompt: Order the stages represented by Mark/Luke: enter city; encounter water-carrier; follow him; speak to householder; be shown upper room; prepare.
nodes.accepted_answer: Enter city → encounter man carrying water → follow him → speak to householder → be shown upper room → prepare Passover.
nodes.accepted_variants: Equivalent grouping preserving the same local sequence.
nodes.rejected_answers: Sequence imported from another witness or invented intermediate event.
nodes.rejection_reason: The order is graded only against the local Mark/Luke instruction sequence.
nodes.success_feedback: Локальну послідовність відновлено без вигаданих переходів.
nodes.partial_feedback: Позначте лише перший неправильно розташований крок.
nodes.failure_feedback: Почніть з входу в місто й відстежуйте кожний дієслівний крок.

nodes.skill_target: cite confirmation that events matched instruction
nodes.knowledge_target: Mark 14:16 / Luke 22:13 fulfilment of preparation instructions
nodes.why_this_node_exists: Links a claim to a direct passage instead of memory alone.
nodes.player_prompt: Cite one passage showing that the disciples found things as they had been told.
nodes.accepted_answer: Mark 14:16 or Luke 22:13, with the proposition that they found things as Jesus had told them.
nodes.accepted_variants: Either passage or both, with semantic paraphrase.
nodes.rejected_answers: A verse that does not contain the completion/confirmation claim.
nodes.rejection_reason: The node asks for the direct completion evidence.
nodes.success_feedback: Доказ завершення прив’язано до точного уривка.
nodes.partial_feedback: Якщо наведено правильне Євангеліє без вірша, попросіть точний фінальний вірш сцени.
nodes.failure_feedback: Шукайте останній вірш у кожному з двох докладних описів.

nodes.knowledge_target: Matthew is more compressed in the defined locating-room episode
nodes.why_this_node_exists: Teaches observation without inventing an authorial motive.
nodes.player_prompt: Which account is most compressed about locating the room, and what observable detail supports that conclusion?
nodes.accepted_answer: Matthew is most compressed: it lacks the Mark/Luke water-carrier sign, follow-him sequence and detailed upper-room description in this defined episode.
nodes.accepted_variants: Equivalent observable-text comparison without assigning motive.
nodes.rejected_answers: Claims about why Matthew abbreviated the event as direct fact.
nodes.rejection_reason: Authorial motive is interpretive unless separately sourced; this node grades observable textual detail.
nodes.success_feedback: Ступінь деталізації порівняно без вигадування мотиву автора.
nodes.partial_feedback: Якщо названо Матвія без прикладу, попросіть одну конкретну відсутню Mark/Luke detail.
nodes.failure_feedback: Порівняйте water-carrier, follow-him sequence і room detail.

nodes.why_this_node_exists: Consolidates direct text, comparison and unsupported identity boundaries.
nodes.player_prompt: Classify five preparation claims as DIRECTLY SUPPORTED / SUPPORTED BY COMPARISON / NOT SUPPORTED BY THIS CORPUS.
nodes.accepted_answer: Luke names Peter/John = direct; Mark says two disciples = direct; Matthew names owner = unsupported; Mark+Luke upper room = supported by comparison; water-carrier certainly equals householder = unsupported.
nodes.accepted_variants: Equivalent labels preserving the five classifications.
nodes.rejected_answers: Any classification that imports an unstated personal name or identity.
nodes.rejection_reason: The board tests provenance and evidence limits, not plausibility.
nodes.success_feedback: Твердження розкладено за силою доказу й походженням.
nodes.partial_feedback: Збережіть правильні рядки й повторіть лише помилковий.
nodes.failure_feedback: Для кожного рядка запитайте: хто саме це прямо сказав?
